objective: Add a browser-safe acquisition adapter for AudioContext output-clock evidence and prevent unavailable or contradicted observations from entering composed audio evidence.

queue_selection.basis: operations/ACTIVE_QUEUE.json contains only V-001 owned by vercel_studio; this slice follows the recorded R-029 next action without mutating canonical queue state.

comparison_against_prior_work.non_duplication: R-029 evaluates clock integrity after capture. R-030 acquires browser observations, preserves unsupported APIs as unavailable, and gates forwarding into that evaluator.

completed: Added single-sample capture for getOutputTimestamp with boundary validation.
Added deterministic multi-sample session acquisition with injectable timing dependencies.
Preserved absent or invalid baseLatency and outputLatency as null rather than zero.
Prevented evaluator invocation when getOutputTimestamp is unavailable.
Forwarded evidence only when the evaluator returns classification consistent.
Added seven isolated boundary tests and a primary-source evidence packet.
limits: No immutable deployment session was sampled.
No physical iPhone Safari evidence was collected.
Browser implementation support remains an empirical question despite specification alignment.
next_action: Integrate the sampler into the exact-commit audio-routing harness so one immutable browser session emits raw capture, clock evaluation, route evidence, and the composed packet under a shared session identifier.
